g.text: S3 - Carry out or cancel a dispatch task (UC-M4-03, UC-M4-04): proposed interaction contract
Pick up the reserved vehicle (Reservation port)
Return vehicle to the held destination space
Consume the hold, complete the system reservation
Vehicle Returned; Available after the normal readiness step
Alternative paths (instead of the normal flow above)
[Vehicle missing, faulty, or task timed out]
Fault event (or clock tick past the timeout)
Complete the task for that vehicle (no move back)
